column2: Hi, I'm Mahmoud Samy, Senior Software QA Engineer from Alexandria, Egypt.
At iHorizons, I lead quality for WOQOD and QNBN.
At Softxpert, I built QA from zero for Autofox, Autolina and Mumzworld, and mentored up to six testers.
Web, mobile, API and database testing, automated with Playwright, Selenium and CI/CD.
Now, AI agents and MCP help me test faster.
ISTQB certified, always learning. Let's connect!
